title: Count categories with an aggregation
introduction: An aggregation summarises matching documents. Your task: Add another category and inspect the buckets.
learningObjectives: Add another category and inspect the buckets.
Explain the example for count categories with an aggregation

blocks.text: An aggregation summarises matching documents. A terms aggregation groups documents by a keyword value.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: The aggs section asks Elasticsearch for grouped or calculated summaries in addition to, or instead of, ordinary hits.

blocks.text: The response contains category buckets with document counts, without ordinary search hits.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Terms aggregation returns a limited set of top buckets by default. Do not assume it always lists every category in a huge index.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add another category and inspect the buckets.
